mapper.insert: insert ignore into conversation_session ( user_id, session_id, title, last_active_time, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{title}, sysdate(), sysdate(), sysdate() )
mapper.update: update conversation_session set title = case when #{role} = 'user' and (title is null or title = '') and #{content} is not null and trim(#{content}) != '' then substring(trim(#{content}), 1, 80) else title end, last_active_time = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{userId} and session_id = #{sessionId}
